name: Lepu Biopharma Co., Ltd.
summary: Lepu Biopharma Co., Ltd., a biopharmaceutical company, focuses on the discovery, development, and commercialization of drug candidates in anti-tumor targeted therapy and oncology immunotherapy in China and internationally. The company offers PUYOUHENG (Pucotenlimab Injection), a humanized IgG4 mAb against human PD-1 for the treatment of MSI-H/dMMR solid tumors solid tumors and melanoma.
